name: Flow diagram of a procedure (numbered stages, boxes and arrows)
use_case: The experimental procedure as a diagram: one row per stage, one box per step, arrows between the steps. Texts come from your table. Photographs and icons are not drawn (add them in Origin or PowerPoint).

data_roles.title: first text column: the step
data_roles.stage: a number column (optional): the row of the diagram

origin_hint: Origin: Insert > Text and Insert > Arrow on an empty graph page (no plot type of its own).
label_policy: labels/peak names only from user files or user confirmation
